dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward a sharpened posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized symmetrical indentations visible at the anterior-lateral margins corresponding to the pectoral junctions, with smooth margins along the mid-to-posterior transition.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity pixel values across the entire dorsal surface with minimal grayscale variance.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast gradient between the white epidermal margin and the dark background medium.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Distinct longitudinal dark-pixel streak on the posterior dorsal midline; small cluster of dark punctate marks located immediately posterior to the blowhole.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark longitudinal linear mark on the posterior dorsal surface near the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly defined dark circular blowhole at the anterior dorsal apex.
